description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in the adjacent lane; Vehicle 3 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane on the exit road. On the exit road, a parked truck partially blocks the right edge of Vehicle 1’s lane near the merge region. After the parked truck, a pedestrian crosses perpendicularly from the left edge to the right edge of the exit road.
